sources.summary: 設施正文2023.10.10；A校區等指定設施介紹、非2027個人接收；查核2026-10-08；重庆大学图书馆按校区和学科布局设立 3 个分馆，包括 A 校区理工图书馆（含声音图书馆），B 校区建筑图书馆，虎溪校区虎溪图书馆（含 4 个舍区书屋、理学分馆、方志图书馆、科幻图书馆），还与学院合作建设有博雅分馆、新闻分馆。馆舍总面积达 59362 平方米，阅览座位 5481 个。图书馆专业馆员 99 名，设综合办公室、学科服务办公室、资源建设部、网络服务部、情报服务部、特藏部、文化育人中心、理工图书馆、建筑图 书馆、虎溪图书馆共 10 个部门，为读者提供全方位的文献服务。馆藏资源丰富，实体馆藏达 517.37 万册，数字馆藏 1424.83 万册 / 件。图书馆有线网络万兆骨干，千兆到桌面，全馆实现无线网覆盖。图书馆拥 有 21 台物理服务器和 381TB 的存储空间，为“双一流”建设、教学科研与拔尖创新人才培养提供了强有力的文献资源保障。 重庆大学图书馆致力于推动学校及社会创新发展提供信息研究及 分析服务，设有教育部首批科技查新站，2018 年获批首批高校国家知识产权信息服务中心，2020 年获批世界知识产权组织在华设立的技术与创新支持中心（TISC）。图书馆积极参与国家、省市级文献资源保 障体系建设，是教育部文献保障体系 CALIS 省级服务中心、重庆市大学联盟资源平台共建单位、重庆市高校图工委常设秘书处所在单位。 重庆大学图书馆馆庆日为每年 10 月 12 日。虚拟形象为书妹儿。吉祥物为学霸雁。 A校区理工图书馆

The toilets and shower facilities on the first and second floors are designated for women, while those on the third, fourth, and fifth floors are designated for men. The laundry room is situated on the second floor. cost_summary: 住宿與生活費用 · 來源矛盾，待確認：當期指南p9InternationalHouse單人depositJPY80000，租35000+util10000/月；雙人租23000+6000，p9未列雙人押金（一般宿舍頁列50000，未年）；Mitra押100000租45000+10000。指南說已扣單人10000/雙人5000住房獎助，不再自行扣一次。寢具指南1960/月 vs一般宿舍頁1980/月，必租/選租亦矛盾；個人2027帳單待確認，非完整生活預算。 2027中文第8頁IntlHouse單人35000＋utilities10000、雙人23000＋6000、deposit80000JPY；Mitra45000＋10000、deposit100000。已扣住房獎學金單人10000／雙人5000，不再重扣；與既有不同版本費表差異待核。 一般Mitra頁寢具1,980JPY/月，與當期指南1,960不同；未印年度不選任一數額作2027確定帳單。（正文第2頁Spring2027；第3–4頁2027春校曆；PDF第8頁；查核2026-10-08）
housing_summary: 住宿與床位 · 來源矛盾，待確認：當期Mitra/InternationalHouse由校方配房，medicalneeds可考量、一般不可改。p8寢具required不可取消 vs p13FirstPayment bedding(optional)，未任選；p9房租說已扣housingSupportScholarship，是否中正個人適用及最終帳單待確認，無保證全額免宿。 2027指南第8頁密特拉館與龍谷國際之家，校方決定房型不可自由改；所有住宿需租被褥1960JPY/月且不可單獨解除，未保實際2027床位。第11頁學校協議住房免租例外仍付utilities，不能自套CCU免費。（正文第2頁Spring2027；第3–4頁2027春校曆；PDF第8頁；查核2026-10-08）

student_guide_sections.title: 課程與學分限制
student_guide_sections.summary: 當期每sem至少登記15JSPcredits（可能變）；完成證書1sem須修得15、2sem30，登記與取得分開。JSP I–III限英文一般大學/研究所課、IV–V可部分日文課，prerequisite/seminar須許可；EnglishTrack申請後通常不能換，1year第2sem可重測由校方決定。specificfacultyagreement不跨學部，非全校所有課均開放。 2027指南第6頁先確認校際或院系交流；EnglishTrack禁日語課，JSP-I–III僅英語本科／研究所課，IV–V可修日語但先修、容量、seminar需教師同意。JSP每學期至少15／全年30註冊學分，必修取得與必須註冊未必取得分開。 interfaculty表Business列Dalianpartner/UGonly、AdvancedSci列CGUEngineering等/Graduateonly；CCU未列该特定清单，不推全部院系可选或所有CCUgraduate不合资格，2027JSP实际指南另适用。

sources.summary: 一般官方incoming／生活／課程頁未明示2027適用年度；查核2026-10-08；CUCバディーズは、新入留学生が慣れない日本での生活に早く馴染み、充実した留学生活を送るために留学生をサポートする学生グループです。CUCバディーズは、良き友人、相談相手として新入留学生の学内外の生活をサポートします。留学生との交流を通して、異文化コミュニケーション能力を磨き、海外の目から見た日本を知ることができます。 国際課で企画する留学生との交流イベントのほかに、CUCバディーズが自らが企画したイベントの開催も行っています。 CUCバディーズの募集については国際課にお問い合わせください。 バディーと留学生の声 大学で日本人以外の学生と交流をしたいと思い、バディー制度に応募しました。 担当したシさんの母国である中国の文化や言葉を学ぶことができ、とても興味深い体験ができました。中国語の単語などを教えてもらえるだけでなく、発音やアクセントまで学ぶことができました。私も日本の文化や日本語を教えてあげました。こうした交流を重ねるうちに、私はバディーから「友人」に変わっていきました。今では、シさんは仲の良い友人の1人です。私が中国に行く機会があれば、逆にバディーになってもらい様々なことを学びたいです。 商経学部商学科2年 松崎 巧 初めて会った時から松崎さんは礼儀が正しく、とても優しい印象で「良い友達になれる」という手応えがありました。松崎さんは本当に面白い人で、私と共通の趣味があったので、頻繁に会って一緒にお昼ご飯を食べました。ある時、日本の醤油の種類があまりに多いため、どの銘柄を選べば良いのか分からなかった時には一緒にスーパーに行ってくれました。料理が得意な彼は醤油のことをよく知っていて、良いものを選んでくれました。私が興味があった日本の学生の生活についても、彼が丁寧に教えてくれたおかげで、いろいろなことが分かるようになりました。 2015年度秋学期交換留学生 シ ジユ 新しい制度なので前例が無く、最初は不安もありましたが担当したクさんとは共通の趣味や明るい性格に助けられ楽しく交流できました。クさんだけでは無くクさんの友人や同じ学部の留学生など友達の輪が大きく広がりました。一緒にランチをたべたり、買い物をしたり、国際センター主催の卓球大会に参加したり、楽しい思い出を作ることができました。このCUC新入留学生バディー制度は国籍という垣根を取り払うことができる制度です。今後はもっと留学生との交流の機会を増やし、留学生が安心して過ごせる雰囲気作りを私達から始めていきたいと思っています。 人間社会学部2年 楠 佳憲 一番思い出に残っていることは卓球大会に参加して、バディーの

Tutors (Buddy System) All NUPACE students are eligible to receive the services of a tutor, a fellow student majoring in a similar field of study. Cross-cultural Exchange Groups There is a host of volunteer groups involved with international students both amongst the campus community and outside. Exchange Activities outside Nagoya During the spring, summer and winter vacations, various associations host home-visits or camping activities. All Tohoku University students and faculty members can take the bus to move between campuses to attend lectures, talks, meetings, student activities, etc. On top of that, students can also use the Aobayama Shuttle Bus to commute from their homes to the university. There are 2 types of shuttle services available : Tohoku University Campus Bus (runs between TU campuses) Aobayama Shuttle Bus (departs from Aobayama station and stops at points around Aobayama campus) Please be advised that although the Aobayama Shuttle Bus can be used by students to commute between their homes and the university, researchers and faculty members are only allowed to use the bus to travel between campuses, and not to commute to the university from their place of residence. IC Card IC Card (icsca) With the IC card “icsca”, you can use the bus and subway systems smoothly. Add funds and use it to travel around Sendai. When buying a new icsca card, you must pay a deposit of JPY 500. This deposit can be refunded if you no longer need your icsca card and return it. Registered icsca cards can be used as bus commuter passes, subway-bus commuter passes, or the Gakuto Sendai Free Pass. Where to buy In addition to ticket vending machines at subway stations, you can buy them on buses, at bus stations, and at some Miyagi Co-op stores. Cards sold on buses and at Miyagi Co-op stores are unregistered icsca cards (JPY 2,000). Click here for the details. Where to add funds You can add funds to your card at subway station ticket machines, bus stations, some Miyagi Co-op stores, and on buses. The “EXPRESS TRAIN” goes to Seoul Station directly and is non-stop, takes about 51 minutes. Regular Train The “REGULAR TRAIN” has 12 stops before arriving at Seoul Station, takes about one hour. From Seoul Station Taxi From Seoul Station, you can take a taxi to Hankuk of Foreign Studies. You can tell the taxi driver “ 한국외국어대학교 가주세요 ” [Hankuk-way-gook-oh-dae-hak-yo ka-jusaeyo] which means please take me to HUFS. Transfer to subway line 1 (Dark Blue Line) and ride the train that is headed in the direction of Yeoncheon [ 연천 ]. Once you get on, make sure to get off at Hankuk of Foreign Studies station ( 외대앞 ). You want to say, “ Can I get a ticket to Cheongnyangni station (청량리) (청량리 가는 티켓 사고 싶어요) ” . The ticket should look like this (MAKE SURE THE NUMBER IS 6002 ) The station that you are getting off will be the last one. From there, you can either take Line 1 subway or take a taxi The taxi fee should be around KRW 7,000 and take about 10 minutes. With our partner Studapart, access hundreds of exclusive offers: studios, flatshares, homestays… and benefit from personalized support throughout your rent! housing.u-bordeaux-montaigne.fr From applying to booking, take all your steps online on the platform. To get started, click on “ Tenant space ” and sign up using your school’s login credentials or your personal email address. Book accommodation online to benefit from the Studapart Guarantee and support from a team of multilingual experts available 6/7d. You don’t have a guarantor living in France ? Studapart can replace your guarantor over the whole duration of your stay. A guarantor is a person bringing financial security and attesting you are creditworthy. It’s difficult to rent a place in France without a French guarantor. In most cases, student residences and landlords require that your guarantor earns income in France. You can get the Studapart Guarantee directly on the platform and add it to your rental application to find accommodation on the Studapart platform or anywhere else! footer-script

The university is located right next to the "Montaigne-Montesquieu" tram stop. By bus : you can get from the train station to Bordeaux Montaigne University on lines 31 and 35 . The night line, TBNight , also serves the campus (Talence, Pessac and Gradignan) on Thursday, Friday and Saturday from 1.30am to 6.30am. By bike : the TBM network provides more than 2,000 self-service bikes, including 1,000 electric ones. You can also access TBM " vélo'c " bike loan, hire and parking service. By car : you can check the rules for the use of foreign licences at https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/N19126?lang=en Useful information At Étu’Recup ’s « Maison du vélo », you can buy refurbished bikes at very reasonable prices. The association also offers bike repair workshops, where volunteers and technicians are on hand to help all participants with their diagnostics and repairs. There, you can also find low-cost second-hand parts. 5 intercity bus routes serve the Talence campus: lines 406, 502, 503, 504 and 505. Bus line 602 (Hôpital Pellegrin - Pieces de Choisy) stops at Bordeaux Montaigne campus (Unitec). sources.summary: 公開一般交通／校園生活；2027春季個人適用尚未核實；查核2026-10-08；eaux Montaigne’s buddy system TANDEM is an online platform where international and local students from Bordeaux Montaigne University can register in order to participate in our buddy system. The International Welcome Desk is responsible for coordinating the matching of pairs. When registering on the platform, each student can specify their expectations and preferences, and once the matching process is complete, the students are free to meet and begin the mentoring relationship. It is up to each pair to decide how they wish to work together. Register directly on the TANDEM platform The buddy system's objectives The objectives of TANDEM are: To facilitate the integration of international students by offering them personalised support from their peers upon arrival; To promote solidarity among students at Bordeaux Montaigne University by fostering mutual support; Encourage exchanges, enabling students at Bordeaux Montaigne University to enjoy an experience of openness and internationalisation within their own institution. The International Welcome Desk will be there to assist you at every step of the process. Furthermore, social and cultural events are organised throughout the academic year for students taking part in the TANDEM programme. This is a pass card that enables students to identify themselves on campus, at the administration of their faculty, in the university libraries, etc. In the city centre, the card will enable you to benefit from student prices, for example at the cinema, for newspaper subscriptions and so on. With the Aquipass card, you can: Enter examination rooms, Borrow books from university libraries, known as the “BU”, Photocopy and print, Pay electronically for your meals in the university restaurants, known as the “RU”, Pay for other services provided by the CROUS. More information on http://www.izly.fr Email account Exchange students get an email account at Bordeaux Montaigne University which you have to activate first. That is the unique email address the university is going to use for all communications. Therefore, you should check the account regularly not to miss any important information. footer-script

Getting around in Strasbourg is easy because the city has a very good transportation system. Trams and buses spread over more than 77 kilometers. Bachelor and master’s students can apply for Student Housing 3 days after they have submitted the application for their study programme. Exchange and guest students can apply for Student Housing as soon as they have submitted the application for their study program. Your application for Student Housing will be cancelled automatically if you are not offered a place at SDU . This means that you will not receive an offer for Students Housing, and you are in no risk of having to pay for Students Housing if you are not offered a place at SDU. You will receive an offer for Student Housing once you have been offered a place at SDU. Please note that it may take a few weeks before you receive the offer for Student Housing. You must accept the offer within a deadline of 6 days. If you regret accepting the offer, you can withdraw your accept within the 14 days cooling off period, which starts on the date you received the offer. You will not be liable for rent until you have accepted the offer and the 14 days cooling off period is over. *An international student is a full-degree student

Rooms typically range from 10-6 m 2 and are furnished with basic items such as a bed, desk, chair, and lighting. The general condition of the housing is reflected in the rent level. Cheaper options are usually older or less modern, but all housing meets acceptable living standards. Kitchens and bathrooms may be shared, and it cannot be guaranteed that you will only share facilities with students of the same gender. Some residences include internet access, while others require students to arrange this themselves. If you leave Denmark for a period (e.g. sabbatical leave, internship or exchange stay), we cannot guarantee new accommodation for you when you return to Denmark. Non-EU students must sign up for 30 ECTS to meet the requirements for the student residence permit. If you wish to take more than 30 ECTS, you must pay tuition fee for courses exceeding 30 ECTS. If you are an EU student, and you wish to take less than 30 ECTS, this must be agreed with your home university, and you must inform SDU International Office about it. Semester ticket, public transportation, mobility With the semester ticket External link (on their thoska ), students can use local public transport in the VMT External link area and regional trains in Thuringia for the entire semester. You will receive your thoska after completing your enrolment. Students can obtain the Deutschlandticket (subscription for public transport throughout Germany; no long-distance trains, cabs or private companies) from the subscription portal of the Jena public transport system External link by crediting the semester ticket. Interested students must submit their application by the 10th of the previous month at the latest. The ticket is issued as a smartphone ticket. Jena's local public transport JeNah External link offers bus and tram lines to all parts of the city. With the semester ticket, students can use these free of charge. The bus schedules can also be found in the DB Navigator External link . There are several long-distance bus providers . It's cheaper than taking the train, but you have to expect traffic jams and delays on the routes (Autobahn). Trains of Deutsche Bahn and its partner companies (in Thuringia: Erfurter Bahn, Abellio) take their passengers to all parts of Germany. The network is very large and most places can be reached with only a few changes. However, one should always expect delays. You can search for travel options and book tickets in the DB Navigator External link . Buying a Bahncard is recommended if you travel a lot and wish to save 25% or 50%. The Deutschlandticket or Sparpreis tickets are the cheapest, but have a train obligation, Flexprice tickets offer reductions and flexibility. sources.summary: 公開一般交通／校園生活；2027春季個人適用尚未核實；查核2026-10-08；residence. After your arrival After your arrival The International Student Office at Ostfalia is also there to help you as soon as you arrive. During a welcome phase before the start of each semester's courses, we will give you a detailed introduction to the Ostfalia infrastructure. We will also advise and support you with all official registrations and show you the important facilities on your campus. Arrival and access to your dormitory room It is important that you let Studierendenwerk Ostniedersachsen know the details of your journey early enough. Only if the StwON staff know exactly when you will be arriving can they leave your room key in a key-safe if necessary. This way, you will have access to your rented room even if there is no member of staff in the hall of residence. Receiving your access data for the Ostfalia infrastructure and your Deutschland-Semesterticket You will receive your access data at the Service Desk of our computer centre. We will be happy to assist you. Please note that you will need to identify yourself when you collect your login details, so please take your passport or ID with you. Registration at the residents' registration office in your place of residence Students who are staying in Germany for longer than 3 months must register at the relevant residents' registration office. The International Student Office at Ostfalia will help you with this. Applying for a residence permit Often the visa is not valid for the entire period of your stay. It is therefore necessary to apply for a subsequent title (residence permit). It is difficult to get an appointment at the responsible local immigration office; there are long waiting times. The International Student Office at Ostfalia will be happy to help you here too. Initial meeting with your supervising professor - planning yo

Das Deutschlandsemester-Ticket gilt bundesweit im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV). Dazu zählen unter anderem U- und S-Bahnen, Straßenbahnen, Trambahnen, Stadt- und Regionalbusse aber auch Regionalzüge (Interregio Express (IRE), Regional Express (RE) , Regionalbahn (RB). Diese Regionalzüge sind mit dem Deutschlandsemester-Ticket nicht nutzbar! Einige innerdeutsche Strecken werden von der Fernverkehr AG betrieben, sind aber für Nahverkehrstickets freigegeben. Diese Freigabe gilt momentan nicht unbedingt auch für das Deutschlandsemester-Ticket. Weiterführende Informationen über Verbindungen der Nahverkehrszüge; S-Bahnen; Busse; Straßen- und U-Bah

cost_summary: 住宿與生活費用 · 來源矛盾，待確認：未标年度估760–810EUR/月（住350–400、食至少180、医保110、广播20、其他100）；不是确认2027費率。；另已讀官方Documents：所有學生StudentUnion fee為summer2027 EUR87。此項日期已載明，但原生活總額仍未核當期，不能將EUR87加成保證完整預算。第三國service fee EUR500的一般degree條款是否豁免雙邊交換仍待核。 同冊第11實體頁exchange82EUR/sem；第43頁regular學生union欄87但total82算式不同，不能把regular nonEU500當exchange必繳或自選82／87；2027實際收費待核。 现行网页区分非EU一般申请60EUR与service500EUR；exchange明示免Service。原规章§6(3)另明确exchange不收该章费用，两次修正规章须一起读，不能把500或60普套CCU。 原规章实际第4页§6(3)交换生费用豁免；§6(1)合作协议另列，不把regular50旧金额当现价。2023原章仍由官方现行法規索引发布，结合修正链，不仅凭文件年份判失效。 首修正仅§9(2)(3)，一般收费从Winter2025/26开始；不修改§6交換豁免。 第二修正只§2改60/500与§4退款，自2025-01-23生效；§6交換豁免未改。故本条申请/service豁免有条文依据，StudentUnion82/87来源差异与2027个别账单另待核，不宣称全部零费。 英語現行費頁交換生列service費免除；Application各phase一般60EUR需與已核原章§6及兩修正鏈合讀，不能把網站一般申請費套CCU。StudentUnion82/87及個人2027費仍另核，不說全部零。（未標示；PDF第3頁；查核2026-10-08）

sources.summary: 一般官方incoming／生活／課程政策未明示2027適用年；查核2026-10-08；does not operate its own dormitories. However, we’ll do our best to help you find suitable housing. Dorm, shared apartment, subtenant, or your own apartment? As a student, you have several housing options, so it’s important to find the solution that best fits your personal lifestyle and budget: Student dorms are already furnished and usually very affordable, which is why they’re so popular. Depending on the dorm, you can even take advantage of mentor programs and events. Shared apartments (WGs) are the most common living arrangement among German students. Here, several students live together in one apartment and split the rent and utilities. Many students who live in their own apartments or in rooms in shared apartments and won’t be using them for an extended period (e.g., while they’re studying abroad) often offer their place for short-term rent. If you’ll be staying with us for a limited time, this could be a good option for you! Having your own apartment is also an option, provided you can afford it. While this gives you maximum independence and privacy, it’s also the most expensive of all the options. You can find more information on the topic of “Housing” on the DAAD website . The early bird catches the worm! The most important thing is to start looking for an apartment as soon as you can. The city of Winterthur dates offers all you need such as shops, bars, museums culture and festivals/events and a beautiful surrounding to relax in the nature. Student accommodations are all close to the SoE and the old town centre. As an exchange student you can explore the Swiss culture, nature and cities all nearby. The Swiss alps with the Dufour Peak (altitude: 4’634 m) or the Lago Maggiore (altitude of 193m) offer various opportunities for relaxed hiking (65’000 km hiking trails) or more thrill-seeking sports such as climbing canyoning or bungy jumping. The cities and villages are known for their rich cultural programs, festivals or traditional events - worth to attend and to meet the Swiss. The Erasmus Student Network (ESN) offers a wide range of activities for students, so it’s easy to connect to the student community. You can reach famous destinations such as Rome, Milano, Barcelona, London, Paris, Vienna, Prague and Berlin in Europe within a few hours using public transportation systems. Spend a weekend there and be back for your studies in time. The cost of living in Switzerland is on a par with other European cities. Depending on lifestyle, the cost of living it is in the region of CHF 1'200–2'100 per month. Incoming students completing a SEMP/Erasmus+ exchange semester are supported with a contribution of up to CHF 420 per month and do not pay any semester fees. Accepted freemovers on the other hand do need to pay the tuition fee. However, both exchange students may apply for a ZHAW School of Engineering (SoE) scholarship which is unique at ZHAW. Learning Approach FHNW School of Business counts with mixed classes where regular local students and incoming students work on group assignments together. To make the semester’s planification easier and to be prepared in those discussions, each course has a semester programme which is available at the beginning of the semester. Grants Conditions Students are required to sign a Grant Agreement (declaration of honour) before arriving. This agreement will be available on Mobility-Online. To be eligible for the SEMP, students must agree the enclosed programme of study ("Learning Agreement for Studies") with their home and host universities before the start of the mobility. Any changes to the programme of study originally agreed must be documented in an updated “Learning Agreement for Studies”. Incoming students must take a minimum of 15 ECTS per exchange semester. Students must be residents in the country of the host university during their study. The minimum duration of a student mobility for studies is three months. More information concerning the exact calculation of the stay can be found in the declaration of honour which must be signed by the students. student_guide_sections.title: 課程與學分限制
student_guide_sections.summary: 當期課程先與faculty coordinator核對並填LA；可另選1–2門其他faculty或Language center，但須與coordinator討論。不是全校無限制混修或任一課必開；課程ECTS/先修依faculty課目另確認。 TransportEngineering一般課表「建議」同field至少4門且大多數本院，另最多2門他院；不是硬性4門門檻／交通路線。 ElectricalEngineering／Informatics至少80%課程本院，先修不足教授可退課；Summer/Winter未載學年，不當2027逐課保證。 Restoration多數理論課Czech，申請前先與faculty coordinator核LA；非全院English-only。 Chemical部分GraphicArts/Photophysics指定printing／graphictechnology背景，課程語言逐課分列；未年課表不推全開。 ArtsPhilosophy一般course CEFR B2+/C1/C1+/C2是個別英語課難度，不能把一般incoming B2要求改成C2；部分course Czech。

Those living off-campus ride their bikes or take city buses to class. Bike If you like cyclying, you'll love Pardubice! The city is flat and bike-friendly with a network of cycling paths. Biking is the fastest way to get around the city. Bus The city has an exceptional public bus service. Buses go frequently and reach all points in the city. Several buses stop at, or just next to, the University campus. These bus stop names are "Polabiny, Hradecká" (buses 3, 7, 17, 33) and "Univerzita" (buses 10, 16). Pardubice city bus schedules are online at www.dpmp.cz . Buy a bus ticket from the driver when you get onto the bus, or buy them in advance from most convience shops or vending machines. Rechargable bus passes are available online at www.dpmp.cz . You can also pay on the bus with your credit card. Once registered, your login credentials will not only grant you access to the eduroam Wi-Fi network across all TBU premises but also allow you to connect to eduroam networks worldwide. First Login Firstly, every new TBU exchange student must first set up their Wi-Fi password to use it. Here is a step-by-step manual: Visit https://wifi.utb.cz/ Enter your TBU Portal username and password in the registration form. Set and repeat the new password. Username Details: Your username is your new TBU login, which becomes active one day after registering at the International Office. For bachelor’s and master’s students , the username follows this format: f_surname , where “f” is the first letter of your first name. If your surname consists of multiple words, include the first two (e.g., f_surname1_surname2). For PhD students , the username is simply your surname. Password Details: Your initial password is an automatically generated Pseudo-Birth Code . Once entered correctly, the system will prompt you to create a new password. Choose and confirm your new password to complete the setup. A new password for Wi-Fi must the different from the password for TBU Portal. The dormitories are close to tram line 4. • To get there, take tram number 1 or 2 from the railway station, go to "Hlavní Pošta" and then change to line 4. • From CAN (bus station), it's better to walk via Husova Street to Klatovská třída (tram stop called "U Práce") and then take tram number 4. Dorm Bolevecká: tram stop "Pod Záhorskem" Dorm Borská: tram stop "Dobrovského" Dorm Máchova 14,16, 20 and Klatovská: tram stop "Borský park"

What can a buddy do for you? - help you to find your way in a new environment (show you the city of Pilsen, nearest shopping mall and other facilites) - wait for your at the station upon your arrival in Pilsen to guide you to the accommodation (dormitory, flat...) - arrange necessary formalities (at the dormitory office, International Office, faculty etc.) - accompany you to a doctor / hospital - help with the communication at various places (dorm manager, bank, post office, exchange office, police station ...) You are only guaranteed housing if you return the signed tenancy contract within the deadline. What to bring All rooms are furnished with a bed, desk, chair and closet. SIØ will place one of these sets in all the international exchange students’ rooms upon arrival. Students will receive an email from SiØ with information about the bedding set before arrival, including information about how to return the set should you not wish to purchase it.
